| *In the context of a country where first-best price reforms to prices of pollution-intensive products are not possible due to either Political Economy, external competition, carbon leakage, or inflation concerns:*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| - Replacing input subsidies with output subsidies. Removing subsidies which are provided per unit of resource inputs used by an industry (e.g., subsidies reducing the price of fuels, water, commodities), and instead providing subsidies per unit of output of that industry. For example, stopping to subsidize coal inputs for the steel sector and instead subsidizing steel output itself, so that steel producers have incentives to increase environmental efficiency while maximizing production in the country, and competition in the industry increases (by adding pollution intensity as a new margin of competition) without losing external competitiveness.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| - Combining environmental taxes with output-based rebates. Taxing resource inputs or emissions of an industry while rebating those revenues back to producers in the industry per physical unit of output produced.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| *If the need for a second-best reform is expected to decrease over time, the above Prior Action can be further strengthened by including a phase-out clause for the output subsidy/rebate.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Reduction/elimination of tax incentives favoring carbon-intensive sectors (first-best), or (second-best) replacing subsidies for environmentally sensitive production *inputs* (e.g., fertilizer, fuels) with subsidies per unit of *output* of the industry or targeted transfers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Mali 2020                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | (P167547)                                                        |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Reducing subsidies and poverty by replacing electricity block tariffs (including “lifeline tariffs”) with uniform electricity tariffs, while ensuring the affordability of energy through lump-sum cash transfers (which can be paid through refundable electricity bills where other cash transfer systems are unavailable).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Removing environmentally harmful tax incentives, including deductions, from direct taxes and replacing them with lumpsum allowances. *For example:* Under the Corporate Income Tax, replacing price-dependent deductions for company cars with lump-sum fixed allowances for business costs; removing CIT expensing of environment-related excise taxes such as fuel/commodity excises, etc. Under the Personal Income Tax, replacing the deductibility of commuting expenses with a lump-sum fixed deduction for work-related expenses.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| Including in the budget, as submitted to parliament, an annex on tax expenditures which quantifies environmentally harmful CIT and PIT deductions as well as deviations from the standard VAT rate for fuels/commodities.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Reducing CIT base erosion, strengthening innovation and reducing emissions by reforming tax expenditures granted under expensing rules of the Corporate Income Tax. Reducing the proportion of R&D expenditures that can be deducted from the corporate income tax in mature, high-carbon industries (where R&D spillovers are smaller) while maintaining such expensing for nascent, low-carbon industries.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Aligning property taxes on cars with carbon intensity or (equivalently) fuel consumption (e.g., as measured by Corporate Average Fuel Economy) or air pollution (e.g., as measured by EURO1-7).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| *At the current stage of evidence, EFI does not recommend its DPFs to promote the introduction of Voluntary Carbon Markets. Prior Actions can, however, support reforms that ensure the orderly regulation of such markets.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| Introducing regulations for Voluntary Carbon Markets that                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| - reduce the risk of fraud, improve additionality of emissions reductions (e.g., by facilitating third-party verifications, moving baseline quantifications from the project level to the sector level \[as in LEAF\] or to the firm level, prohibiting VCMs from purchasing permits from compliance markets with adjustable caps),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| - ensure that, where VCMs allow the purchaser of offset certificates to increase their emissions elsewhere, these emission increases do not exceed the emissions reductions achieved by the offsets purchased (risk arising in all situations where less than 100% of offset projects are additional and effective) by implementing scaling coefficients for the tonnage of emissions increases permitted per ton of offset purchase, starting low and then revising as the VCAM proves its mitigation effectiveness                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| - facilitate the normal collection of Corporate Income Taxes on offset revenues,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| - reduce disincentives created by the structure of offset sales for adopting new national climate policies (e.g., by avoiding to credit emission reductions relative to emissions baselines that either fall or create new government liabilities when other climate policies are adopted) such as by using historic emissions baselines (as in LEAF) or international trajectories for the average emissions per physical unit of products in the VCM-covered industries.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Reducing evasion of existing environment-related taxes by repositioning the point of tax collection such that it coincides with a tax chokepoint (which is generally not the point of the value chain where the environmental damage occurs).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| *For example:* Moving from hard-to-enforce taxes levied directly on carbon emissions generated at the time of fuel combustion to more enforceable taxes levied at the chokepoint where fuels enter the economy. Moving from commonly evaded taxes levied on deforestation in the rural interior of a country to more enforceable commodity taxes levied at chokepoints like seaports.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Improving the simplicity of administration, clarity of price signals and enforcement of environment-related taxes by converting off-budget (“para-fiscal”) environmental fees into standard taxes, administered by the general excise tax authorities, included in standard revenue management and revenue strategies. Merging co-existing taxes covering the same tax base (e.g., property taxes and fees on vehicles, commodity taxes and charges relating to damages caused by the same commodities, excise taxes on fuels and prices on emissions from the same fuels).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                  |
| *Where this is not possible:* Adopting a decree requiring the Finance Ministry and the Environment Ministry to annually publish an official update on the alignment between general tax policy and para-fiscal market-based environmental instruments (including tradeable emissions permits and environmental fees), including overlapping tax bases (e.g., Finance Ministry excise taxation of fuels and Environment Ministry’s pricing of CO~2~ emissions from the same fuels).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Rescaling tariff rate structures (which are generally lower per physical unit of high-carbon goods and environmentally damaging goods than for sustainable goods) by reducing excess tariffs on Greentech (or on goods with accredited sustainability certificates) or removing preferential tariff rates for high-carbon goods (i.e., evening out tariff rates to create a level playing field in trade, removing hidden, environmentally harmful subsidies created through the tariff system structure).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| # Budget Policy                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+

| For example: In a country in which there is excessive pollution from old cars that are kept in circulation long past their socially optimal economic life, or in which car wrecks are dumped into nature rather than brought to recycling centers: Establishing a revenue-neutral deposit-refund system where the agent who first introduces the car into market circulation (e.g., the garage or importer) is charged a fee and where the agent who takes the car out of market circulation (e.g. the person delivering the car a crushing facility at the end of its lifecycle) receives a reward. EPR chains can then be further extended, e.g., by giving the car crushing facility the right to return the car back to the original producer of the car. |                                     |
